newsitem.title: UK: Ocean Group rises after in line H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Ocean Group rises after in line H1 results.

text.p: Shares in marine and environmental services firm Ocean Group Plc climbed on Thursday on relief that the company reported half year profits in line with analysts' expectations, dealers said.
Ocean shares gained 16p to 533-1/2p by 0757 GMT in volume of 77,000 shares.
"I think the shares were oversold prior to the results and now the figures look OK, the stock is back to where it should be," said one dealer.
Ocean made pre-tax profits of 32 million stg in the six months to June 30. Analysts had expected pre-tax profits to be in a range between 29 and 33 million stg.
